title: Ground Breaking Dedication - Elevate Branson
summary: C onstruction has begun and we’re celebrating with all our friends, supporters, advocates, and neighbors!

paragraphs: C onstruction has begun and we’re celebrating with all our friends, supporters, advocates, and neighbors!

Please join us to celebrate this important milestone. Elevate Community is set to be one of the largest, permanent, tiny home communities in the country. The dedication will include brief comments from key advocates, a blessing of the project, and an honorary tree planting to commemorate the occasion.

Please note that this is an outdoor event at a real construction site. Dress is smart or business casual. Standing for the event and available parking will require comfortable walking shoes. The event will take place rain or shine and no RSVP is required.
If you have any questions, call Elevate Branson at 417.335.9915 or email [email protected] .
